summary: As an aspiring programmer, I have created a game set on Mars. In this game, you control an astronaut who must explore, survive, and build. The astronaut will face many obstacles. I am participating in this competition because, ever since I was a child, I have dreamed of visiting NASA.
details: The game is based on the scenario of future missions to Mars and features many obstacles.
